record.question:
Consider the following statements based on the Viksit Bharat Youth Parliament 2026 (National Round)
    held from June 15–17, 2026 in New Delhi.
      1. It was held at Bharat Mandapam, Pragati Maidan
      2. It was organized by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
      3. The opening function was inaugurated by Lok Sabha Speaker, Shri Om Birla.
      4. Participants at the national level of the 2026 Youth Parliament were selected from 575
          universities/institutions across India.
    Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
